title: Here and Back
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：here　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 here 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Here, in 1976 the writer put the page at the shelf, and everybody in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the writer had put the page ② here in silence, and nobody had asked a single question. The writer had come to the study two months earlier, and spoke little of the study he had left behind him.

The manuscript for January 1970 puts it plainer. The page was ③ here, and the reader who kept it wrote of the page ④ here in the same line; nothing in the study was ever left here for long in those days. The reader wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ here, and ⑥ Here came the reader who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the study had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript. What the line asked for was that the page be copied ⑦ here at the shelf, and that everybody be ⑧ here before the January rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried here.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986 she put the page ⑨ here twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Here, she said in 1988, that was the part the study never forgot; the manuscript still speaks of it here. She kept the page in the same shelf for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the study never forgot how here it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 在这里（句末状语，置于宾语之后：put the page here，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 在这里（作表语，说明处所或去向：the page was here）
C. adv. 到这里（置于句首：Here, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 到这里（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the page here）
E. adv. 到这里（作介词宾语：from here）
F. adv. 到这里（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Here came the reader）
G. adv. 在这里（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be copied here at the shelf）
H. adv. 在这里（be here 说明所在或去向：everybody be here before the rains）

answers.why: here 意为“到这里”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Here, in 1976 …。
here 意为“在这里”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had put the page here。
here 意为“在这里”，此处作表语说明那件薄薄的书页的去向或所在：was here。
here 意为“到这里”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the page here。
here 意为“到这里”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from here。
here 意为“到这里”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Here came the reader。
here 意为“在这里”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be copied here at the shelf。
here 意为“在这里”，be here 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。
here 意为“在这里”，1986 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次放置那件薄薄的书页，副词置于句末。
here 意为“到这里”，母亲 1988 年那句话以地点状语开头：Here, …。

叔叔是从在这里回来的。（from here）
记录要求那件薄薄的书页在书架被誊在这里。（be copied here）
